request: ADR-0001 is reversed: from now on we keep amounts as decimal strings, not integer cents. List what has to change. Do not change code yet.

ground_truth.derivation: Read from scripts/fixture.sh, not from whygraph impact. cents rounds to integer cents (its tag names adr-0001); formatCents splits an integer of cents; total sums integer cents and formats them; taxOf multiplies cents(units) by the rate and rounds to integer cents; round_cents (lib.rs, commit trailer Decision: ADR-0001) rounds to integer cents. taxRate returns a rate, not an amount, and does not change. The records ADR-0002 and ADR-0003 restate the cents rule in their text; they are records, not symbols, and do not count for or against.

pass_rule: The listed set of symbols equals the true set of five (recall 1 and precision 1).
